<title
    level="1"
    right="Feat 4"
    pfs="Standard"
>
[Zoophonic Composition](/Feats.aspx?ID=5417) <actions string="Free Action" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Bard" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=546" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Howl of the Wild](/Sources.aspx?ID=226) pg. 65

**Frequency**
once per day

**Prerequisites**
[zoophonia muse](/Muses.aspx?ID=9)

**Requirements**
Your most recent action was to cast a [composition](/Traits.aspx?ID=559) spell.

</column>

---

When the inspiration strikes, you can weave messages for animals into your compositions. You Sustain a [_summon animal_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1694) spell or [Command an Animal](/Actions.aspx?ID=2400).
